CPU peak memory is shown for N = 1,000,000 only, net of the benchmark harness's own copies (36 bytes per sample on eagle's arms). At smaller N this harness cannot resolve it: each measuring process inherits the launching process's peak, so smaller readings show that floor rather than the workload. The cards keep the raw readings; the next card run measures every size directly.
